title: Sri Sai Balaji Residency Owners Welfare Association vs GHMC & 2 others
one_line_summary: GHMC issued notice under Sec. 636 GHMC Act to demolish the parking-level structure alleging setback violation.
court: Court Hall 12, High Court for the State of Telangana

hearings.outcome: Admitted; interim suspension of demolition notice for 8 weeks
hearings.order_sheet: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner. Admit. Notice. Pending further orders, there shall be interim suspension of the impugned notice dated 22.04.2025 for a period of eight weeks. List on 07.08.2025.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji GHMC WP - admitted, interim suspension for 8 weeks (Pinnamaneni J never gives open-ended interim). Ravi Shankar garu (secretary) very relieved. Must keep extending the interim on every date.
hearings.client_interaction: Sent written update to association secretary Ravi Shankar Mallela: notice suspended for 8 weeks.

hearings.listed_for: counter-affidavit by respondents / extension of interim order
hearings.outcome: Interim order extended; GHMC sought time for counter
hearings.order_sheet: Learned Standing Counsel for GHMC seeks time to file counter-affidavit. Interim order extended for eight weeks. List on 08.10.2025.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji WP - GHMC SC (Hemalatha Ravuri) sought time for counter. Interim extended 8 weeks. Fine.

hearings.listed_for: counter-affidavit by respondents / extension of interim order
hearings.order_sheet: Counter-affidavit not filed. Interim order extended till the next date. List on 26.02.2026.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji WP - still no counter. Interim extended. Pinnamaneni J told SC 'this is the last time without counter'.

hearings.listed_for: counter-affidavit by respondents / extension of interim order
hearings.outcome: Counter filed in part; synopsis ordered
hearings.order_sheet: Counter-affidavit of respondent No. 2 filed. Paper book exceeds 200 pages; both sides to file synopsis. Interim order extended till the next date. List on 01.07.2026.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji WP - GHMC counter filed, huge, with building plans - 230+ pages with ours. Judge wants synopsis from both sides (her standard >200 pages rule). Draft 3-page synopsis.

hearings.outcome: Synopsis filed by petitioner; respondent 3 counter awaited
hearings.order_sheet: Synopsis filed on behalf of the petitioner. Counter-affidavit of respondent No. 3 awaited. Interim order extended till the next date. List on 12.08.2026.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji WP - filed our synopsis. R3 (Town Planning) counter still not filed. Interim extended.

hearings.outcome: Counter of R3 filed; petitioner's counsel undertakes to file reply within three weeks
hearings.order_sheet: Counter-affidavit of respondent No. 3 filed and served in court. Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to file reply affidavit within three weeks. Interim order extended till the next date. List on 04.09.2026.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji GHMC WP (WP 14872/25). R3 counter served in court today. I undertook to file our reply/rejoinder within 3 WEEKS - judge recorded it word for word in the order (her habit). So due by 2 Sept. R3 says the setback violation is 1.2 m on the east side - our approved plan says 1.5 m setback was left. Need the approved plan copy from Ravi Shankar garu + the 2014 occupancy certificate.

action_items.task: file reply (rejoinder) affidavit to counter of R3 - undertaking to court
collect approved plan and 2014 occupancy certificate from association secretary

hearings.outcome: Reply affidavit on record; receipt acknowledged by GHMC Standing Counsel
hearings.order_sheet: Reply affidavit filed on behalf of the petitioner is on record. Interim order extended till the next date. List for hearing on 05.10.2026.
hearings.note: Sai Balaji WP - our reply was filed yesterday 3 Sept (diary no. 4471) - ONE DAY late on the undertaking, judge did not comment. Hemalatha Ravuri (GHMC SC) acknowledged receipt of the reply copy in court today, 4 Sept, signed on our copy. Listed for final hearing 5 Oct. Keep the approved plan flagged at page 64.
hearings.client_interaction: Updated association secretary: reply filed, final hearing on 5 October, interim continues.
